verdicts.reason: A breaks up the composition. The tree/MERRY/characters cluster is pushed left of centre and there is a large dead gap before the red monster, ghost and star monster, which are jammed against the right side. The bell is missing, the left edge is empty, and the headline is no longer centred. B keeps the original intact and centred, but it is just a shrunk copy: wide empty bands on both sides, a tiny 'DISCOUNT' headline, and nothing rearranged to fit the wide banner. Of the two, B is more coherent and on brand.
